title: refactor(objectql): move the master-detail and related-record bodies out of engine.ts into engine-master-detail-related.ts (#25522 cut 14)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCCGkxPYszKz5GSKF3wnMYs)_ Part of #25522 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6348891160 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：把 `engine.ts` 里「引用完整性与主从解析」一段的 4 个方法体（主从外键落地、写入预检的主记录、校验规则谓词读取的关联记录、一跳关联读取）原样搬进新文件 `engine-master-detail-related.ts`，类上方法签名与注释不变，只把方法体换成转交；只被这些方法体用到的 2 个小工具函数随之搬走，与留下的方法共用的 4 个工具函数原地加 `export`、由新文件导入（不复制）。`engine.ts` 22,423 → 22,085 行。 - **为什么改**：#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 14 刀。缝表重测后净减行最多的是 `validate`（约 −438），但它要共用的一个工具函数一旦导出，发布的 `.d.ts` 就会重新排序（内容相同、字节不同、分块文件名改变），不符合本刀「字节相同」的硬线，所以本刀改取第二名。 - **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，无行为变化；公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件逐字节不变；新文件与 `engine.ts` 互相导入（运行期循环），已用一次性探针在新旧两版构建产物上逐行对照（33 行完全一致），且发布包把两者打成一个文件。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine-master-detail-related.ts`（搬入的方法体、两个随迁工具函数与 `MasterDetailRelatedHost`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里 `resolveOneHopRelated` 的转交桩与四处原地 `export`、`packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts`（新文件的一行分类）。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`，应见 472 个测试文件全部通过。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 Cut 14 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6432376812`, which carries the seat's shared-module-helper ruling for this cut. Four bodies of the "Referential integrity and master-detail resolution" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-master-detail-related.ts`: `settleMasterDetailLanding` (the UPDATE payload a master-detail FK repoint actually lands with), `resolvePreviewParents` (the write preview's master-detail headers), `resolvePredicateRelated` (the related rows a validation-rule predicate reads) and `resolveOneHopRelated` (the one-hop reference reads it and formula fields go through). No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/project-thread-39lx12` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `5507225e3`, which contains cut 13's merge (`b7f8a2ebdb`, #26403), with `main` merged in once at `6746140361` (clean; no merged commit touches `packages/objectql/**`, and `engine.ts` is the same blob at both bases). Nothing was edited before that merge landed: the move was measured and dry-run on #26403's head while it was in the queue. `engine.ts` at `5507225e3` is the same blob (`4e64ab23e37a`) as at #26403's head, and the five files committed here are byte-identical to that dry run (`git hash-object`, 5 of 5; the move script regenerates both source files byte for byte). ## What changes ### Why this area Re-measured on `5507225e3` (after cut 13's merge) with cut 11's measure script, unchanged, and a price step under this cut's seat ruling (`price3.mjs`: a helper a paying body shares with a staying body is exported in place and blocks nothing; one read only by moving bodies moves with them). Both earlier screens still apply (query-options erasure sites, 8 at base; module-helper closure). `engine.ts` is 22,423 lines, 7,148 of them from the last 30 days (`git blame --since=2026-09-27T03:05Z`). `scripts/pm/git-history.mjs count`: 131 commits in 30 days, 36 in 7. `class ObjectQL` holds 318 members, 255 methods and accessors.

The full per-method screen and price list are in the project file `pm-orders/server/25522-cut14-seam-table.md`; the move script is `pm-orders/server/evidence/25522/move-cut14.mjs`. | area | paying bodies | net | verdict | |---|---|---|---| | validate | 1 body (469 lines, 345 from the last 30 days), 7 shared helpers exported in place | priced -439; -438 measured on a dry run (suite green) | **out under the ruling**: exporting `insertStaticReadonlySubject` alone changes the published `.d.ts` bytes (below) | | **Referential integrity and master-detail resolution** (this PR) | 4 bodies (327 lines) + 2 helpers that move with them; 4 shared helpers exported in place | priced -292 (bodies only); **-338 measured** | pays most of what the ruling admits; no open PR touches it | | Package, app, plugin and driver registration | 4 bodies (264 lines; `registerMetadataCollections` 166) | about -233 | **overlaps #26337**: `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`, read only by `registerMetadataCollections` and so moving with it, gains `'queues', 'assignmentRules'` in that PR | | Readable-ids security and permission/formula resolution | 9 bodies (216 lines) under the ruling; `resolveReadableIdsSecurity` stays (`this` as a value), the two ADR-0139 bodies stay | about -156 | pays less: nine short bodies, nine stubs | | Delete cascade and reference walking | 7 bodies (167 lines) | about -124 | pays less; most of the section reads private statics | | count / aggregate, Query lowering, the rest | - | -71 or less | pays less | **Why `validate` is out.** Measured by exporting each of its seven shared helpers on its own on the base and building (`dts-helper-export-variant.sh`): six leave all six declaration files byte-identical; `insertStaticReadonlySubject`, whose return type is `ReturnType`, makes the declaration bundler pull the `rule-validator` declarations in earlier. The result is the same declarations in another order (sorted lines equal for `index.d.ts` and `core.d.ts`; the chunk differs only in the order of two import specifier lists), but `index.d.ts`, `core.d.ts` and the shared chunk change bytes and the chunk's file name changes (`util-CVzOGxAn` to `util-lvlZ9vs9`). The seat's ruling for this cut asks for byte-identical, so this cut takes the next area. The `validate` dry run (`move-cut14-validate-dryrun.mjs`; 472 files / 8,789 tests green, AST compare SAME) is kept in the project files for whoever decides it; see Acceptance notes. ### The shape - The class keeps all four methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Three bodies become one host literal of exactly the `MasterDetailRelatedHost` members they read, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 14]`, as cuts 8 and 10 to 13 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`logger`, `_registry`, `formulaHopReads`); methods go as late-bound closures (`find`, `resolveMasterDetailParents`, `materializeParentHeader`, `buildReferentialFieldClear`, `resolveOneHopRelated`, `resolveEnginePosture`, `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads`), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches. No moved body assigns a field, so there is no setter (cut 13's setter ruling has nothing to apply to). - `settleMasterDetailLanding` reads no member of the class, so its method calls the function directly with its type parameter (`return settleMasterDetailLanding(args);`), the shape cuts 3 and 16 of #25467 used for a body that reads no `this`. - **Helpers, under this cut's seat ruling.** `withoutKey` and `staticReadonlyStripTakes` are read only by `settleMasterDetailLanding`, so they moved with it, docblocks included and byte for byte (`staticReadonlyStripTakes` reads `staticReadonlyStoredView`). Four helpers are read by these bodies AND by bodies that stay: `masterIdOf` (`resolveMasterDetailParent`, `resolveMasterDetailParents`, `update`), `servedAsStored` (`validate`), `undeclaredRelatedFields` (`resolveFormulaRelated`) and `staticReadonlyStoredView` (`update`, and the moved `staticReadonlyStripTakes`). Each stays declared where it was, byte for byte, and gains `export` in place; the module imports the four from `./engine.js`. Before that import the module imported only the type `ObjectQL` from `./engine.js`. `index.ts` and `core.ts` name their exports singly, so nothing new is published (below). - **The run-time cycle (measured).** That value import makes `engine.ts` and the module import each other. The module runs nothing at evaluation (declarations only), and `engine.ts` imports it right after `./federated-object.js`, after every module the moved bodies import, so the evaluation order of every other module is unchanged. Measured on the built bundles: the `// src/...` region order of `index.mjs`, `core.mjs`, `index.js` and `core.js` at head equals the base's with one line added, the new module, between `federated-object` and `in-memory-aggregation` (100 to 101 regions in `index.mjs`). The bundles hold both files in one module, so the published build has no cycle. The late-binding probe answers the same on base and head (Tests). - **Imports.** The module imports `referenceTargetOf`, `EngineQueryOptions` (type), `isStoredMetadataBodyObject`, `ExecutionContext` (type), `postureEnforcesWall`, `resolveTenantFieldName`, `carriesOrganization`, `collectPredicateRelationships`, `referentialClearBinding`, `readonlyWhenFkJudgementReadsParent`, the two binding types, `resolveMasterDetailRelation` and `isFederatedObject`. `engine.ts` drops `postureEnforcesWall`, `collectPredicateRelationships`, `referentialClearBinding` and `readonlyWhenFkJudgementReadsParent`, whose last readers moved; the last one's own two-line comment moves with its import into the module. - The module header names what moved, what stays and why, and how the helpers were handled. ### Net lines (the seat's rule) `engine.ts` goes from 22,423 to 22,085 lines, **net -338** (40 added, 378 removed). The module is 512 lines. With the three path readers below, the diff against `origin/main` is 949 changed lines over 5 files (+565 / -384). ### Readers of the moved lines - `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 29b anchored `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#resolveOneHopRelated`, the elevation read site that moved; it now anchors `engine-master-detail-related.ts#resolveOneHopRelated`. `check-system-context-census` passes at 153 read sites, as at base. No `NON_READ_ANCHORS` row names a moved member. - `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys its rows `FILE#FUNCTION :: SEAM`: the three `resolveOneHopRelated` rows and the `resolvePredicateRelated` row are re-keyed to the new file, dispositions and reasons unchanged. - `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` lists every non-test file that calls `referenceTargetOf(`: the new module gets a `not-a-served-read` row. Its reason carries the half of the `engine.ts` row's `also` text that described `resolvePredicateRelated`, which now has one home with the body, plus `resolveOneHopRelated`, the one-hop loader those reads and the formula fields go through as the caller's own `find` (as the federated test's row for it says). The `engine.ts` row keeps its `executes` classification for `expandRelatedRecords`, which stays, and the sentence on the engine's privileged callers. - No `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/qa/**`, `content/**` or `scripts/**` names a moved member or helper. No ADR anchor paragraph describes a moved body (the `engine.ts` entry is the transaction-seam paragraph). No moved body comment cites an ADR decision letter. No moved body holds a `query-options/no-any-erasure` site (8 at base and head), a tenant-audit untyped receiver, a private static read, or a `.canReadObject(` call. - **Read-seam census (the cut-21 trap of #25467).** `check-durability-degradation-log-level` names two moved bodies in read-seam entries (`guards find() in resolvePreviewParents()` and `in resolveOneHopRelated()`). Its `--list` at head names the same 82 seams with those two now under the new file, and nothing else differs once line numbers are masked; the gate passes. - **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `5507225e3` (clean detached worktree): 91 anchored files, **1,877** decision-letter citations, 59,295 resolving citations across 8,376 files. At `main` `6746140361`: 1,876 (main's own movement since). At head `85d27dca7` (that `main` merged in): **1,876**, the same. On the pre-merge pair it was 1,877 and 1,877. The count is unchanged because the moved bodies carry no decision-letter citation. ## Why #25522 splits `engine.ts` one seam at a time so that a change to one area reads, reviews and conflicts as that area alone. This cut takes the section that pays most under this cut's rulings and that no open PR touches (table above). Nothing about what the engine does changes. ## Tests No test is added or changed apart from the re-keyed rows above: the move is proved by identity, not by new behaviour.

The other 10 are the 3 import edits, the 4 helpers that gained `export` (byte-identical after it), the 2 helpers that moved (byte-identical in the module: `withoutKey` 526 characters, `staticReadonlyStripTakes` 1,464) and the class. The head adds one statement, the module import.
Late-binding probe (base and head dist) `zz-probe-cut14.mjs` (a one-off, not committed) loads the built `ObjectQL` and drives all four methods with doubles set on the instance for every member the host reads (`find`, `resolveMasterDetailParents`, `materializeParentHeader`, `buildReferentialFieldClear`, `resolveOneHopRelated`, `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads`, `_registry`, `formulaHopReads`, `logger`), then prints results, the call order on the doubles and the log lines. Cases: the repoint and system arms of `settleMasterDetailLanding`; `resolvePreviewParents` for a caller, for system, and with a throwing `find` (the warn arm); `resolvePredicateRelated` for a caller, for system, and under the referential-clear binding; `resolveOneHopRelated` through the predicate path, the caller path, and with a `formulaHopReads` double. The 33 output lines are identical on base and head, which is the check the seat's ruling asks for on the run-time cycle. The module-order measurement on the bundles is under "The run-time cycle" above.

## Verification Head `85d27dca7b0789e71c1d8074bd985bbdb0646ee0`. The gate list is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff at that head (89 commands, no STALE warning), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`. - **Derived gates: 89 of 89 exit 0.** `--ran` reconciliation: `89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. That includes `check:skill-examples` (265 prose examples type-check) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (112 entry points across 69 packages load), which refuse without a build and so ran after the client closure build; and `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, which refuse on a shallow clone and so ran after `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-22 origin main` and `git fetch origin 621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4`. - **Hand gates, exit 0 each:** `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` (counts above), `node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs`, `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs`, `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`, `node scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs --list`, and eslint as `pnpm lint` runs it (`--no-inline-config`) on `packages/objectql` and the core pin test. - A first full pass on `e77aac466`, before `main` moved, derived 95 commands: 93 exit 0 and the two build-reading gates refused (exit 3, not measured). The re-run above replaces it. ## Acceptance notes - **Serial order.** Nothing was edited until `origin/main` held cut 13's merge (`b7f8a2ebdb`). The branch is cut from `5507225e3`, which contains it. - **Overlap.** Open PRs touching `packages/objectql/**` or the three re-keyed files, listed just before opening this: #26337 and #26138 (`validation/rule-validator.test.ts` only, not touched here). #26337 edits `engine.ts` in the imports, `OperationContext`, `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`, after `SECURITY_SERVICE_SOURCE_SLOT`, and in `readUpdatePriorRow` / `insert` / `update`, none of them moved here, and it edits a different row of `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`. `git merge-tree` of this head with #26337's current head (`290a435afc`) exits 0, no conflict.
